originality.rationale: The exact five-row joint symbol-pair weight enumerator classification of all thirty coordinate-ordered E8 codebooks, and its intrinsic plane-incidence formula, was not established by the directly inspected primary papers or indexed mathematical records. value.rationale: The problem is intrinsically motivated by the coordinate-order dependence of a standard binary code on overlapping-pair read channels. The new incidence classification identifies precisely which ten of thirty labeled E8 realizations attain the pair-MDS Singleton limit, with five complete weight spectra and an analytic criterion. The whole classification refines prior existence constructions and a single Hamming-code example; no unsupported real-world performance benefit is claimed.
